corrections.text: The article quoted Michael Amalfitano as saying, "With the new Phenom 300EV, we are raising the bar once again," citing AVweb. This quote does not appear in AVweb's report, or in any of the other three cited sources; AVweb does not quote Amalfitano at all. The quote has been identified as unsupported and should be disregarded. The second Amalfitano quote in the same article, "Through purposeful innovations combining enhanced safety technology, amplified performance, and thoughtful cabin refinements, we have introduced meaningful advancements that make flying more intuitive, seamless and enjoyable," is independently verified verbatim in the cited AeroXplorer source.

The article's "What We Don't Know" section stated that Embraer "has not said whether current Phenom 300E owners will have any retrofit path" to the new systems. This is inaccurate: Corporate Jet Investor, cited elsewhere in the article, reported that "it will not be possible to upgrade an existing Phenom 300E to a Phenom 300EV." Embraer has addressed the question, and the answer is no.
